  1: 'Defense & Space',
  99: 'Venture Capital & Private Equity',
  100: 'Think Tanks',
  94: 'Research',
  7: 'Semiconductors'
};

const webhookBody = $('Webhook Trigger').first().json.body;
const industryIds = webhookBody.industry_ids || [];

const mappedIndustries = industryIds.map(id => ({
  id: id,
  name: industryMap[id] || `Industry ${id}`,
  found: !!industryMap[id]
}));

const industryLookup = {};
mappedIndustries.forEach(ind => {
  industryLookup[ind.id] = ind.name;
});

return [{
  json: {
    success: true,
    message: `Mapped ${mappedIndustries.length} industry IDs to names`,
    data: {
      industries: mappedIndustries,
      lookup: industryLookup,
      requested_ids: industryIds,
      found_count: mappedIndustries.filter(i => i.found).length,
      not_found_count: mappedIndustries.filter(i => !i.found).length
    },
    errors: []
  }
}];
